description: The complete Singapore income tax computation for 2026, as on the return. Covers: Resident progressive rates 0% to 24% (Year of Assessment 2024 onwards) on 2026 income; Employment, sole-proprietor and rental income; no capital gains tax; the S$80,000 relief cap; Earned income, CPF, spouse, child, parent, SRS, CPF cash top-up and donation (250%) reliefs; Employee CPF by age and status with the S$8,000 monthly and S$102,000 annual ceilings; Non-residents: the higher of 15% flat and the resident rates, 24% on other income, the 60-day exemption; Tax already paid and the balance; no withholding on salary. Returns the tax, the balance still to pay or to be refunded after taxes already paid, every option the law offers compared, and each step with its legal reference. All amounts in SGD; everything is optional, give only what applies. What is not modelled is listed in the result.

inputSchema.description: An individual's Singapore income tax for income earned in 2026 (Year of Assessment 2027, Form B1), with CPF. Amounts are Singapore dollars for the whole year; leave out what does not apply.

receipts.description: Business or professional receipts, Singapore dollars for 2026

children.description: Unmarried children under 16 (or studying full-time) whose income is S$8,000 or less (Qualifying Child Relief)

cpf_status.description: citizen (citizen or PR from the 3rd year), pr1 or pr2 (PR in the 1st or 2nd year, graduated rates), foreigner (no CPF). Default citizen

days_in_singapore.description: Non-residents: days in Singapore in 2026 (60 days or less can exempt short-term employment). Default 365

disabled_children.description: Of those, children with a disability (Child Relief (Disability), S$7,500)

disabled_parents_apart.description: Dependent parents with a disability living apart (S$10,000)

disabled_parents_living.description: Dependent parents with a disability living with you (S$14,000)

allowances.description: Allowances and benefits in kind, Singapore dollars for 2026

bonus.description: Bonus and other additional wages, Singapore dollars for 2026

cpf_employee.description: Employee CPF actually paid; leave out to compute it, Singapore dollars for 2026

expenses.description: Employment expenses incurred wholly and exclusively for the job, Singapore dollars for 2026

salary.description: Gross salary (basic pay), Singapore dollars for 2026

other_income.description: Other taxable Singapore income (pensions are taxed only if from Singapore sources), Singapore dollars for 2026

parents_apart.description: Dependent parents you support but who live apart (S$5,500)

parents_living.description: Dependent parents living with you (Parent Relief S$9,000)

rebate.description: Personal Income Tax Rebate, if one is announced (none announced for the Year of Assessment 2027), Singapore dollars for 2026

cpf_top_up_family.description: Cash top-up of CPF accounts of loved ones (relief up to S$8,000), Singapore dollars for 2026

cpf_top_up_self.description: Cash top-up of your own CPF accounts (relief up to S$8,000), Singapore dollars for 2026

donations.description: Donations to approved charities (deducted at 250%), Singapore dollars for 2026

other.description: Other reliefs you are entitled to, as an amount, Singapore dollars for 2026

srs.description: Contributions to the Supplementary Retirement Scheme (cap S$15,300; S$35,700 for foreigners), Singapore dollars for 2026

expenses.description: Interest, repairs, property tax and other expenses, Singapore dollars for 2026

residency.description: resident (in Singapore 183 days or more, or under a concession) or non_resident. Default resident

spouse_income.description: Spouse's income for the year (Spouse Relief needs S$8,000 or less), Singapore dollars for 2026

tax_paid.description: Tax already paid for the year (GIRO instalments), Singapore dollars for 2026
